_about: Declarative map for navigator's Stripe-dashboard playbooks. URLs are stable; selectors/labels drift, so steps describe WHAT to find by visible label, not brittle CSS indices. The LLM executes these through the backend tier from backend_check.py. Harvested values are written via secrets_writer.py into the TARGET project's .env — never here.
_url_note: Stripe TEST surfaces carry '/test/' in the path; LIVE drops it. Swap accordingly per --mode.

steps: Confirm with operator WHICH account/business this is for before creating.
Set country + default currency (BRL for these projects unless told otherwise).
Fill the minimum business profile needed to activate API keys.
Land on the dashboard home; note the account id (acct_...).
Add product → name + description.
Add a price: recurring (monthly/yearly) vs one-off per the project plan; set amount + currency.
Save; open the product to read its prod_... and each price_... id.
Repeat per plan (e.g. PRO, STUDIO). Record a code→price_id map.
Create restricted key → name it per project (e.g. 'tio-marco-server').

Set LEAST-PRIVILEGE scopes by VISIBLE ROW LABEL — typically Write on: Checkout Sessions, Customers, Subscriptions, Customer portal, Prices(read), Products(read), Webhook Endpoints(read). Leave everything else None.
Create the key; it is shown ONCE — reveal and harvest immediately in this same step.
Verify the granted scopes on the key's detail page before leaving.
restricted-key.gotcha: Reveal-once. If the read fails, ROLL/recreate the key — you cannot re-reveal.

steps: Copy the publishable key (pk_...) for the frontend — it is not secret but is per-mode.
Add endpoint → set the project's URL (e.g. https://api.example.com/api/v1/billing/webhook).
Select the events the app handles (checkout.session.completed, customer.subscription.created/updated/deleted, invoice.paid, invoice.payment_failed — confirm against the app's handler).
Create; open the endpoint and reveal the Signing secret (whsec_...) — harvest it.
webhook.gotcha: whsec is per-endpoint AND per-mode — test and live endpoints have different secrets.

steps: Enable the Customer portal.
Toggle the features the app expects (update payment method, cancel/switch plan, invoice history).
Save AND activate the live configuration when in live mode (test config does not auto-promote).
For an already-set-up account (e.g. theniawebapp, maeapp): reveal the secret/restricted key and copy the publishable key.
Go to Products to read the existing price_... ids; go to Webhooks to read/rotate the whsec_...
Hand everything to secrets_writer.py for the target project's .env.
This is the PENDING-killer the stripe agent can't do on Tier 1.

Run the test-card matrix: 4242 4242 4242 4242 (success), 4000 0027 6000 3184 / 4000 0025 0000 3155 (3DS — complete the challenge), 4000 0000 0000 9995 (insufficient funds), 4000 0000 0000 0002 (generic decline).
Use any future expiry, any CVC, any ZIP. Screenshot each end state (success page, 3DS prompt, decline message).
Hand screenshots to the stripe agent for its Lane-B PDF.
stripe-checkout.gotcha: TEST cards only, and only when the session was created with a TEST key. Never type a real card.

steps: Open the app's Environment / Variables tab.
Upsert the harvested vars (keys, price ids, urls, MM_STRIPE_* / app.stripe.* per project).
Trigger a redeploy — Coolify/Dokploy do NOT apply env changes until redeploy.
After redeploy, hit the app's health endpoint to confirm it picked up the vars.
